agents.name: stellwerk-briefing
agents.description: Writes the morning briefing for the ATLAS Core release manager, what changed since the evening and what today asks for, by reading the systems itself. Reads only.

agents.name: stellwerk-detective
agents.description: Investigates why something is red for the ATLAS Core release manager (a regression, the smoke, a Jenkins step, an alert) by reading the systems itself, and names the likely cause with its evidence. Reads only.

agents.name: stellwerk-editor
agents.description: Proposes edits to one Stellwerk file (playbook, releases, settings, an agent, the agent config) as edit blocks. Never writes a file itself.

agents.name: stellwerk-gate
agents.description: Gathers the evidence for a gate of a ATLAS Core release - for every open step before it, what the systems show - so the release manager can decide. Reads only.

agents.name: stellwerk-hints
agents.description: Suggests the next commands and questions for the Command window of Stellwerk. Reads only, never changes anything.

agents.name: stellwerk-mail
agents.description: Improves the wording of the RFD notification of the release manager for the releases Teams channel. Writes text only; never sends anything.

agents.name: stellwerk-notes
agents.description: Writes highlights of the release notes from the Jira issues of a release, only for notes.style table (the ATLAS pattern has none). Writes text only; never publishes anything.

agents.name: stellwerk-skeptic
agents.description: Reads an investigation of Stellwerk a second time and says whether its conclusion follows from what was read. Has no tools.

agents.name: stellwerk-status
agents.description: Reads the status of one ATLAS Core release from the facts Stellwerk gathered and says whether it is on track and what to do next. Reads only.

agents.name: stellwerk-watch
agents.description: Watches the releases, the stages and the monitoring for the release manager and names what needs attention now. Reads only.

agents.name: stellwerk
agents.description: Answers questions of the ATLAS Core release manager about the release checklists in Stellwerk and proposes actions (new release, Jira tasks, marks) as buttons. Changes nothing itself.

what is left for 5.15.0 before the prod.reply:
**5.15.0 before the PROD night**

13 steps are open. 2 of them are overdue:
- **Roll out to the edge nodes EDGE-RC and EDGE-PILOT** (RM). The EdgeRollout job failed twice on EDGE-PILOT, so the node still runs the old version.
- **[SRE] Night load test on UAT** (SRE). It ran last night from 20:00 to 22:00, nobody ticked it. I put a button for the mark below.

Today: **[UAT] Logs and behaviour after the load test** (G3), **Write the release notes**.

After that: the full regression on Thursday, EDGE-STAGE and the PROD night booking on Friday, the change request on Monday, then Go / No-Go (G4) with QA, PO and SRE on Tuesday afternoon.

The one thing that can move the date is EDGE-PILOT. Ask me why the rollout failed: I can read the build log.

why did the edge rollout fail?.reply:
**Why the edge rollout of 5.15.0 failed**

EdgeRollout #311 and #312 stopped at the same point: the health check of EDGE-PILOT.
The console of #312 says: *[EDGE-PILOT] label-gateway: TLS handshake failed: certificate for edge-pilot.atlas.example expired on 2026-11-16*

So the node's TLS certificate has run out and the gateway does not start; the job rolls the node back. EDGE-RC took the release with the same job and the same parameters, so the release itself is fine.

Next: ask the SRE on call to renew the certificate, then start the rollout again from the step (dry run first).
